final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, risk_margin_count * 1.0 / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS distance_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY time_in_force
